user.title: Connect to Trakka
user.description: Create an API token in Trakka (Settings → Integrations → API tokens), then enter it here with your Trakka server's address.

data_description.url: The address you open Trakka at, e.g. https://trakka.example.com or http://192.168.1.10:8080.
data_description.api_token: Starts with trk_. It is shown only once, when you create it.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a server with a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: New Trakka API token
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for {url} no longer works (it was probably revoked). Create a new one in Trakka (Settings → Integrations → API tokens) and enter it here.

data_description.api_token: Starts with trk_. It must belong to the same Trakka account.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Trakka
reconfigure.description: Change the server's address, the API token or the certificate check. The account must stay the same.

data_description.url: The address you open Trakka at, e.g. https://trakka.example.com or http://192.168.1.10:8080.
data_description.api_token: Starts with trk_. It is shown only once, when you create it.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a server with a self-signed certificate.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the Trakka API at this address. Check the URL, and that Home Assistant can reach the server (no login page of a reverse proxy in front of /api/v1).
error.invalid_auth: This API token is unknown or was revoked.
error.invalid_token_format: A Trakka API token starts with trk_.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Trakka account is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The new API token is saved.
abort.wrong_account: This API token belongs to another Trakka account.

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant fetches your lists, in seconds. Changes made from Home Assistant show at once.

add_item.name: Add an item with details
add_item.description: Adds an item to a Trakka list, with a quantity, an aisle, a price or the urgent flag. On a Courses list, a product already there is updated instead of added twice.

aisle.name: Aisle
aisle.description: The store aisle to file the item under.

auth_failed.message: The Trakka API token is unknown or was revoked.

read_only_list.message: The list {list} is shared with you read-only.
